data_description.connection_type: Modbus TCP uses a gateway with MBAP framing; RTU-over-TCP is only for transparent serial servers.

connection.title: BRINK connection settings
connection.description: Monitoring-only is the safe default and does not write to the ventilation unit.

data_description.port: Use 502 for a Waveshare Modbus TCP-to-RTU gateway, or a serial device path for RS485.
data_description.baudrate: BRINK default: 19200, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit.
data_description.control_enabled: Enable only if you intentionally want Home Assistant to write settings. It never enables Modbus control automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to BRINK device. Please check: 1) Serial port path is correct, 2) USB to RS485 converter is connected, 3) Slave ID matches device setting (default: 20), 4) Wall controller is disconnected. Check logs for detailed error message.
error.invalid_input: Check the connection settings, host, TCP port, and slave ID.
error.invalid_response: The gateway connected, but the BRINK did not accept the read-only appliance-type request.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Check Home Assistant logs for details.
